subject: Deployment mode follow-up: SSO, KMS/HSM, logging retention
summary: Post-demo qualification: clarifying whether FintechCo will use Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or Private VPC based on SSO, KMS/HSM requirements and logging retention. Action items: provide SSO/KMS integration notes, draft MSA redlines, procurement contact.
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode follow-up: SSO, KMS/HSM, logging retention

Hi Alex — great walkthrough earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can align on the right deployment option.

Recap (from our call):
- Primary concern: regulated data (transaction records) — need control over key management and audit logs.
- SSO: you run Okta; want SCIM/OIDC for user access into the Console.
- KMS/HSM: want customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) for model data at rest.
- Logging retention: legal requires 7 years for audit traces, prefer logs to stay in their VPC or to be exported to your SIEM.

High-level recommendation based on what you told us: Private (VPC or on-prem) if KMS/HSM + long-term logging in your environment are non-negotiable. Dedicated could work if you accept Redwood managed KMS with CMK import and log forwarding options (we can extend retention via S3 export). Hosted API would be the fastest, but likely not suitable given the KMS and retention constraints.

Can you confirm which constraints are hard blocks vs. preferences? Also please share procurement contact (or loop them in) so we can start draft MSA/redlines.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll share a short technical note on SSO/KMS options and what we can support in Dedicated vs Private.
2) Michael will outline logging export/retention patterns and required changes for 7-year retention.
3) If procurement is ready, we’ll send a draft MSA with the initial redlines (attached).

Attaching: FintechCo_Security_Reqs.pdf (their questionnaire we pulled from the demo).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 17:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up: SSO, KMS/HSM, logging retention

Thanks Marissa — that matches our notes. To answer your question: KMS/HSM is a hard requirement for production (we need BYOK or HSM-backed CMKs). Long-term logging is also a hard requirement (7 years). For SSO, OIDC is preferred but if SCIM is easier to implement quickly that's fine.

Procurement contact is procurement@fintechco.com (I’ll loop them in on the next reply). We’re targeting a July go-live for a pilot if integration work starts next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the technical note.

—Alex

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up: SSO, KMS/HSM, logging retention

Hi Alex — looping in the technical side here. Quick notes on options and tradeoffs: 

1) SSO (Console access):
- Hosted/Dedicated: support OIDC for admin console + SCIM for user sync. Setup is straightforward (metadata exchange + test user).
- Private: same support, but you can also host our control plane in your VPC which removes any OAuth egress concerns.

2) KMS/HSM (key management):
- Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS only — not acceptable for your BYOK requirement.
- Dedicated: supports customer-managed keys using a customer-supplied CMK in supported clouds (we can import key material or integrate with your KMS via external key reference, depending on cloud provider). HSM-backed CMK can be used if your provider supports it.
- Private: full BYOK/HSM support — keys never leave your VPC/HSM. This is the only option to guarantee HSM-backed separation in all cases.

3) Logging retention/export:
- Hosted: logs retained per our default policy; we can forward logs to your S3/Cloud Storage or SIEM but long-term retention requires export pipeline you control.
- Dedicated: we can set up direct log streaming to your S3 with lifecycle policies to meet 7-year retention; can also offer an option to store logs in a customer-managed logging account.
- Private: logs remain inside your environment — easiest to meet compliance.

Recommendation: Given BYOK/HSM + 7-year retention are hard blocks, Private VPC is the conservative choice; Dedicated may be acceptable if the cloud provider and HSM integration path meet your HSM guarantees.

Action items from our side:
- I’ll draft a short tech note summarizing the KMS/HSM integration steps and the configuration differences between Dedicated and Private (attaching a draft).
- If you can share the target cloud provider and whether you require FIPS/HSM-certified modules, that’ll help us validate Dedicated feasibility.

Attaching: Draft_MSA_Redlined.docx (we’ll iterate with procurement).

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>

Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up: SSO, KMS/HSM, logging retention

Thanks Michael — that helps. We run GCP (GKE) and expect to use Google Cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM equivalents). FIPS is required for some workloads. For the pilot we can accept Dedicated if you can demonstrate HSM integration and the logs export meets retention controls; if not, we’ll need Private.

Procurement (procurement@fintechco.com) — looping you in to start MSA review and pricing discussion.

Next from us: share expected volumes and pilot scope by EOD Tuesday so you can validate cost/throughput estimates.

—Alex
